posterior_rule: R8 multi-phase absorption reversal: treat each phase independently. Negative flow with falling price is delivered downside; if the next phase still has negative flow but price rises sharply, that is seller absorption/covering and a causal reversal. The final reversal can own the close even when total session flow remains negative.
lesson: The blind final direction was right but missed the deep intraday round-trip. That last phase is a classic seller-absorption reversal; session flow of -2441 cannot be read as bearish by sign alone.
carry_forward: For Friday and all mature swings, score flow conviction by phase, not by session aggregate. Opposite-sign price/flow in a late phase can reverse the chain and must feed the weekend handoff as realized exit state.
